blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around 9.8 million Filipino families considered themselves poor in the third quarter of 2026, according to a survey by Octa Research. Based on Octa’s Tugon ng Masa survey conducted from Sept. 28 to Oct. 4, self-rated poverty stood at 37 percent in the third quarter, equivalent to 9.8 million families. The figure was two percentage points lower than the 39 percent, or approximately 10.3 million families, recorded in the second quarter. “The 2-percentage-point difference is within the survey’s ±3% margin of error, so self-rated poverty is statistically unchanged from the previous quarter,” Octa said.
